title: Migrate pdfjs-dist 5.x -> 6.x (clears GHSA-hq66-cqwq-w95j)
description:
The dedicated migration bead that eshyra-1yj (closed 2026-06-07, PR #121) said
would be filed and never was. That bead added the semver-major ignore for
pdfjs-dist to .github/dependabot.yml; its final acceptance criterion was to
explain "why PDF.js major updates require a dedicated migration bead". This is
that bead.

## Why now

Dependabot alerts #26 and #27 (both open since 2026-08-08, both high) are one
advisory counted against two manifests:

- GHSA-hq66-cqwq-w95j, "PDF.js: Arbitrary JavaScript execution upon opening a
  malicious PDF"
- vulnerable range >= 5.6.83, < 6.2.108; first patched 6.2.108; latest 6.3.289
- we are on pdfjs-dist 5.7.284 (packages/core/package.json:49, range ^5.7.284),
  devDependency scope

There is no patched 5.x, so the only fix is the major. Dependabot cannot open a
PR for it: an `ignore` entry in dependabot.yml suppresses security updates for
that dependency as well as version updates, and pdfjs-dist semver-majors are
ignored there by design. Repo setting dependabot_security_updates is enabled;
the config, not the setting, is why there is no PR. That is the ignore working
as intended - it routes the work here - but it means the alert will sit open
until this bead is done or the alerts are dismissed.

## Call sites

Only two, both under packages/core/scripts (never shipped to CLI users):

- packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/extract.ts:45
- packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts:40

Both import `getDocument` from 'pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs' and use only
getDocument -> getPage -> getTextContent, reading `str`, `transform`, `height`,
and optional `width` off each text item. extract.ts declares those fields as a
local structural type (PdfTextItem) rather than importing the library's deep
types, so the typing coupling is already thin. Confirm the legacy ESM build and
that exports subpath still exist in 6.x - that entry point, not the extraction
API, is the likeliest breakage.

## The real risk is output drift, not the API

The API surface is small. The hazard is that 6.x changes extracted text and
therefore the generated rules-packs. That puts this squarely under
docs/importer-fix-protocol.md: do not weaken regression tests or audit
expectations to match new generated output. Any diff in extracted text must be
explained against the source PDF and either fixed in the extractor or justified
with source-backed evidence that the old expectation was wrong.

Extraction behavior this repo has already had to fix by hand, all of which must
be re-checked after the bump: hyphen-cluster normalization (eshyra-6uy),
two-column layout handling (eshyra-fct, eshyra-xbh, eshyra-w8h), apostrophes
mis-mapped to space (eshyra-g9im.1), and section-anchor matching
(eshyra-0m9.5.20).

## Sequencing

Interacts with eshyra-o9bd.14 (regenerate pack + re-run the full PDF/source
audit and new gates, then re-freeze). Both regenerate the pack from the same
PDF. Doing them in an undefined order risks attributing pdfjs output drift to
the thaw work or vice versa. Decide the order deliberately and record it: either
land this first so o9bd.14 regenerates once on 6.x, or finish o9bd.14 first and
treat this as a separate, isolated regeneration. Not filed as a hard blocker in
either direction - the sequencing is a judgement call for whoever picks these up.

## Acceptance criteria

- pdfjs-dist range in packages/core/package.json moved to >= 6.2.108 (prefer the
  current latest, 6.3.289) and the lockfile updated.
- Both call sites build and run; the legacy ESM entry point resolves.
- Extracted text is either byte-identical to the 5.7.284 baseline, or every
  difference is explained against the SRD 5.1 PDF under
  docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, with the extractor fixed where it is wrong.
- Generated rules-packs regenerate deterministically; frozen-path changes carry
  a thaw note under docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/.
- npm run verify:worktree clean.
- Dependabot alerts #26 and #27 close on their own once main carries the fixed
  version. The semver-major ignore in dependabot.yml STAYS - the policy from
  eshyra-1yj is still correct for the next major. If it is intentionally
  changed, that is a separate decision to record.
notes: PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/535 open. Extraction byte-identical 5.7.284 -> 6.3.289 (403 pages / 34347 lines); pack unchanged (0 records added/removed/changed); only API break was PDFDocumentProxy.destroy() removal at extract.ts and create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts. Bead stays in_progress until the PR merges.
